messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 抱歉，我目前沒有可用的工具來查詢個人運動員的排名。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" They want the current top-ranked tennis player. We need to retrieve the ranking. The tool sports_team_standing expects team_name and league. But tennis is not a team sport; it's an individual sport. The tool is for retrieving standings of a sports team in its league. There's no direct tool for retrieving individual rankings. We can interpret "team_name" as "player_name"? But the tool expects a team name. There's no tool for retrieving tennis rankings. So we cannot use the tool. We should respond that we don't have a tool for that.
